description: Source code for a Kivy-based live shader editor application, including shader code snippets, class definitions, and application logic.

classes.name: ShaderViewer
classes.description: A widget for displaying and updating shaders with rendering context.

classes.name: ShaderEditor
classes.description: Main widget for editing shader source code and managing shader compilation.

classes.name: ShaderEditorApp
classes.description: Kivy application class that builds and runs the shader editor interface.

methods.name: update_shader
methods.description: Updates shader parameters such as projection matrix, time, and resolution.

methods.name: on_fs
methods.description: Setter for fragment shader source property.

methods.name: on_vs
methods.description: Setter for vertex shader source property.

methods.name: compile_shaders
methods.description: Compiles the shader source code by concatenating headers and user code, then updates the viewer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for the Kivy application, initializes the ShaderEditor widget.
